item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

I kinda like the core of this idea; the way the tattoo works and what it does, and the angle of it being a victim of a biker gang getting revenge and stuff works for me.

The narrative does not: it's perhaps a personal thing but I generally do not like when all of the central narrative in an article is backstory: my general preference is that the Foundation are the protagonists of the story since the article is written from their POV; and so everything has to be centred around what they know.

My other concern with it is that it feels very flat: there's no emotional highs or escalation or anything; so it just kinda feels like a sequence of events that happen without it feeling like it's building up to something or going somewhere; and so the ending feels very conclusive but almost unearned because there's not really any kinda sense of catharsis or w/e when it's finally contained.

So yeah: my advice is that this has elements which work, and it feels like a good setting for a story; but it also feels like the actual narrative isn't quite there: it feels like there's this opportunity for a great SCP-4205 style story; where we see the Foundation struggling to contain this or w/e or someone affected by it slowly like, coming to terms with their imminent death; and it kinda feels like you have the angle for this but not necessarily the meat of the agents emotional arc?

item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
With the changes to the narrative made, yes, I'm comfortable with giving you a tentative greenlight. Potential for body horror here if you focus on a story of violence and vengeance for the victims.

After transferring the corpse to a foundation facility, one of the retrieval agents would discover a tattoo of unknown origin on his back after feeling a stinging sensation and seeing the scp taking the form of a Wolf as well as a few dozen tattoo-like claw marks surrounding the main tattoo.

Keep that theme in mind when you write the rest of these portions. If the agent is also afflicted, for example, does it suggest that he/she too is a "violent" person? If so, how will you reveal these portions of their backstories so the readers can connect the dots?

Looking forward to reading the draft once you get your second greenlight! All the best!

item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
The first four bullet points are fine, and make sense. I have a better understanding of how the scp functions, thank you.

it favors more exotic predators such as extinct ones as a means of attracting more prey since the more intricate a tattoo the more it would attract tattoo enthusiasts.

I still don't understand what you mean here. To clarify: for .e.g. a tattoo of a sabretooth tiger appears on the victim's skin, followed by more "extinct" predators? I don't get why this would "attract" tattoo enthusiasts though.

I think the problem is you're missing a target, or specifically, the scp is missing a goal. That's why I asked who is being targetted and why. If the main target of the scip is "Tattoo enthusiasts", then you have to justify this and come up with a more plausible mechanics of how this happens. If the target audience, on the other hand, are violent gangs (who just happen to be heavily tattooed), then ah… do you see how the motivations / goals of the scp changes? Perhaps the entity was murdered by a gang member in the past

You're close to a greenlight. I just need you to work out / decide on a few more details.

Thanks for the criticism, I appreciate it.

Unfortunately due to the fact there is a 400 word limit from what I’ve been told and read for these posts I can’t put alot of details in without going over the limit so I’ll answer your questions here! So in Order:

  • I was thinking a possible minor memetic ability it has causes the host prey have false memories of getting the tattoo in order to lull the prey host into a false belief.
  • Basically what i mean is that more tattoos would appear on the prey hosts body taking the form of claw/bite marks like one would see on a carcass after a animal chews and claws at it.
  • On the outside the victim looks completely fine with no physical wounds anywhere on the body save for the tatto markings. Autopsy however would show that random organs/muscle tissue seemed to have mysteriously vanished with no answers as to how and what caused it. This is what also caught the attention of the foundation.
  • The Tattoo appears randomly, ranging from a few minutes to days before its next manifestation as well as its victims being random as well with no pattern being apparent.
  • i have the scp set up in a way it favors more exotic predators such as extinct ones as a means of attracting more prey since the more intricate a tattoo the more it would attract tattoo enthusiasts.
  • Basically its hunting style would be similar to species that try to disorient/separate prey in an attempt to get the host to leave the sight of anyone around them so it can strike.

I made an attempt to add more detail to the actual article so i hope it as well as my answers help in painting a picture of this scp

item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there MisterNightmare013. Let’s take a look at your concept.

+crit
-crit

Unfortunately, I’m not sure I completely understand how your scp functions at the moment. So it’s a predatory tattoo that “appears” on random people’s skin? Why wouldn’t the victim automatically be suspicious of its appearance?

Claw mark-like tattoos over existing tattoos/bare skin that seem to sting as would normal claw marks would also appear.

What does this mean? Perhaps you should clarify your wording.

Eventually it would kill its victim in the way the predator its based off would normally kill its prey (bruises associated with being constricted being tattooed on the victim or gashes from claws as well)

Similarly for this statement. How exactly does a victim die? More importantly, why is this happening to victims? How/when does the tattoo appear or choose its victims? There are also sections of your central narrative that jump about and don’t make sense, mainly:

- why would the Foundation investigate a random string of murders? What made them anomalous to begin with?
- why is the Foundation agent sensing a stinging sensation?
- “the form of extinct species of Kaprosuchu” what’s the relevance of this?
- “the Agent willingly accepted being contained and observed to determine the entities behavior.” I’d think the Foundation would conduct more than just observations if they discovered the entity was a tattoo.
- “Its main way of hunting would appear to try and make its prey paranoid all the while it toys with its prey.” I still don’t understand how this would work. Perhaps you could give a specific, detail example.

The concept itself sounds cool, but I have a feeling you have not fleshed out the exact mechanics of your proposed scip. As a result, its anomalous properties sound random / too fantastical and as a result, I can’t really imagine the scp as realistically working.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. Best of luck!

item.title: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-#### “The Predatory Tattoo” is an entity in the form of a tattoo usually appearing to look like various predatory creatures. It primarily targets individuals with various tattoos and violent past. A minor memetic effect caused the host prey to retain false memories of receiving the tattoo at some point. As time goes on the victim will notice slight imperfections with the tattoo, such as movement and its eyes seeming to be staring. More tattoos seem to manifest on the host taking on the appearance of bites and claw marks. Eventually after some time has passed the prey host will collapse, dead from unknown causes.

Central Narrative: The anomalous entity would first be discovered after a string of mysterious deaths amongst a biker gang was brought to the attention of the foundation. Investigations of the coroner’s reports on the latest victims showed no outer wounds but upon autopsy revealed several missing organs and parts of muscle tissue. Agents retrieved the recent body and files on previous victims. After transferring the corpse to a foundation facility, one of the retrieval agents would discover a tattoo of unknown origin on his back after feeling a stinging sensation and seeing the scp taking the form of a Wolf. Upon discovering the entity, the Agent willingly accepted being contained, examined and observed to determine the entities capabilities. After the agent's death, the skin of the agent's back was removed, preserved and placed in a frame-like container with physical contact being heavily restricted to prevent containment breaches.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: it has two primary ways of transferring to a new prey host, either by direct touching where it is inhabiting or by viewing the scp for a certain amount of time however these depend on several factors the primary being if it had recently fed and the ability to transfer can be prevented via two way mirrors in its containment cell.

Additional Notes: As stated, normal tattoo removal methods don’t seem to work. Additionally a prey host would report seeing glimpses of violent acts and the appearance of the various victims of the scp as well as what appears to be a destroyed motorcycle and a group of people driving away from the hosts POV as well as describing a sense of hatred towards the unknown figures despite not knowing who these figures are.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. Also, please note the Ideas Critique required reading wordcount limit; your post is about 73 words over. Please address this before seeking further feedback. ~Zyn
